### Domains & Carrier ([OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean))
- `Point = Fin 85`, `Line = Fin 85`, `Old = Fin 7225`, `New = Fin 17`.
- Explicit carrier `Vertex = Old ⊕ New` (|`Vertex`| = 7242).
- [`oldEquiv`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L19) maps `Old ≃ Point × Line` via label $l + 85p$. Global [`label`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L23) maps `.inl v ↦ v` (<7225) and `.inr j ↦ 7225 + j`.

### Incidence & Spread ([OppositeIncidenceSpreadSlots.lean](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeIncidenceSpreadSlots.lean))
- [`Inc linePoint p l`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeIncidenceSpreadSlots.lean#L8-L9) $\iff \exists i, \text{linePoint}\ l\ i = p$ (literal list membership; no field/GQ existence assumed).
- [`spread`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L15) (`Fin 17 → Line`) and [`spreadOwner`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L16) (`Point → Fin 17`) are fixed literal tables with arbitrary indexing.

### Adjacency ([OppositeGQ35SpreadGeneric.lean](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadGeneric.lean))
[`graph.Adj`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadGeneric.lean#L9-L14) four cases:
1. **Old–Old**: $u \neq v \land \text{Inc}\ p_u\ l_v \land \text{Inc}\ p_v\ l_u$ (cross-incidence).
2. **Old–New**: $\text{Inc}\ p_u\ l_u \land \text{Inc}\ p_u\ (\text{spread}\ j)$ (flag $u$ on spread line $j$).
3. **New–Old**: Symmetric to (2).
4. **New–New**: `False` (independent set).

### Diameter & Target ([SingleExtension.lean](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/SingleExtension.lean), [OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean))
- [`DiameterAtMost G D`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/SingleExtension.lean#L15-L16) $\iff \forall u\ v, \exists p : G.\text{Walk}\ u\ v, p.\text{length} \le D$.
- [`FinalClaim : Prop`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L30-L31) $\iff |V|=7242 \land (\forall v, \text{deg}(v) \le 25) \land \text{Diam} \le 3 \land \neg(\text{Diam} \le 2)$.

### Analysis
- The generic slots interface proves degree bounds conditionally under premises `hline` and `howner`.
- [`FinalClaim`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ44SpreadDefinitions.lean#L30) is purely a closed concrete `def` (`Prop`), **not** a completed theorem; no proof is supplied.
- Missing definitions: None; interpretation is syntactically self-contained.
